description: Deep Frontier new-game setup of the built-in Meander map: a river looping around the central start plateau between low terraced bluffs. Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites lie on the southern bluff by the map edge and on the north-east bluff, Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites beside the start and in the south-east corner, sandstone and limestone outcrops beside their pits east of the start, five Human Record Caches by the ruins, the reactor on the north-west plateau and the launch pad on the north bluff; the map has no room left for three of the 12x11 plants.

unmet.reason: Meander has very little flat ground in large pieces: a greedy count finds at most 11 disjoint flat, dry 12x11 rectangles on the whole map, while the loop needs the 20x15 reactor, the 12x12 launch pad, two 10x11 Deep Mines, two 11x9 Deep Drills, two 11x7 quarries, five 10x9 Archive Excavations and twelve plants of 10x9 to 12x11. An integer-program packing of every large footprint (door cell kept free; about 28,000 candidate positions with dense positions thinned to every other cell; the reactor fixed on the north-west plateau) solved to optimality placed every site except the Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant, Radioactive Waste Refinery and Water Treatment Plant (all 12x11); with the final layout no flat, dry, free 12x11 footprint with a routable door remains.
